message_text: My financial aid package was way less than expected. Who can I talk to about this?
I'm sorry to hear that. You can submit a Financial Aid Appeal through the Student Portal, or schedule a meeting with a financial aid counselor.
I already tried calling the office 3 times and nobody picks up.
I apologize for the difficulty reaching our office. Wait times have been longer during peak season. You can also email finaid@university.edu for a response within 2 business days.
2 business days when my deposit is due tomorrow? That's not helpful.
I understand the urgency. Let me connect you with the emergency aid line. You can also request a deposit deadline extension through the Admissions portal.
